title: Fast and Stable Gradient Approximation for Bilinear Forms of Hermitian Matrix Functions
summary: Objectives involving bilinear forms $u^\top f(A(θ))v$ for Hermitian $A$ arise widely in scientific computing and probabilistic machine learning. For large matrices, Lanczos efficiently approximates these quantities, but differentiating them with respect to $θ$ is challenging. Existing approaches either backpropagate through the Lanczos recurrence, requiring reorthogonalization for stability, or apply Arnoldi to an augmented block matrix of twice the original size.
